'''ThrillSpace Travel''' was a travel company founded by [[Grabathar]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] war hero from the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. ThrillSpace offered tours of exotic locations across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
